step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identifies entry points for user data from mobile/web clients (User Devices / UserConsumerWebMobile).
2. Logs flow into Input EKS microservices, then through Fluentd log collector to Raw S3.
3. DynamoDB user attribute changes trigger DynamoDB Streams into Kinesis Data Streams/Firehose, landing in Raw S3.
4. Lambda performs batch filtering on raw files in Raw S3 to isolate user activity logs.
5. ETL Athena enriches raw data with mappings and outputs structured dataset into Gold S3.
6. Advertisers set target rules in Admin portal, stored in Segment RDS.
7. Evaluation EKS builds Athena queries using RDS metadata and queries Gold S3 via Query Athena.
8. Evaluated user segment lists are stored in low-latency Segment DynamoDB.
9. Ad Server queries Evaluation EKS and fetches user segments from Segment DynamoDB to return recommendations under 200ms.

graph.name: Buzzvil User Segment Processing Platform Architecture
graph.categories: Analytics, Data Pipeline, Ad Tech, Serverless
graph.notes: Buzzvil's architecture for user activity log collection, serverless Athena ETL into Gold dataset, and sub-200ms targeted ad segment processing using EKS, RDS, and DynamoDB.

nodes.name: User Devices
nodes.notes: Incoming traffic from mobile SDKs, web browsers, and server-to-server integrations

nodes.name: Input EKS
nodes.notes: Microservices cluster running backend APIs that emit activity logs

nodes.name: Fluentd
nodes.notes: Fluent Bit/Fluentd log collector daemon forwarding container logs

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Stream
nodes.notes: Captures user attribute updates via DynamoDB Streams and streams them via Firehose to S3

nodes.name: Filter Lambda
nodes.notes: Batch processes raw log files to filter out unwanted request logs, reducing CPU load on log forwarders

nodes.name: Raw S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores raw unfiltered logs and user attribute updates

nodes.name: ETL Athena
nodes.notes: Enriches raw logs with internal ID mapping metadata

nodes.name: Gold S3 Bucket
nodes.notes: Stores curated, enriched gold user dataset ready for segmentation queries

nodes.name: Admin
nodes.notes: Admin system where advertisers define targeting conditions and segment rules

nodes.name: Ad Server
nodes.notes: Serves ad recommendations requiring low-latency (100-200ms) segment targeting lookups

nodes.name: Segment RDS
nodes.notes: Stores segment metadata, conditions, and catalog rules

nodes.name: Evaluation EKS
nodes.notes: Runs periodic evaluation jobs that construct and submit Athena segment queries

nodes.name: Segment DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Stores evaluated user segment membership data for fast ad server lookup

nodes.name: Query Athena
nodes.notes: Executes segment evaluation queries against the Gold S3 dataset

edges.notes: User events and requests sent to microservices on EKS
EKS containers output log streams to Fluentd
Fluentd pushes log files into Raw S3 bucket
Filter Lambda processes raw batch files in S3 to extract clean activity logs
DynamoDB Streams publish user property updates to Kinesis
Kinesis Firehose writes user property streams into Raw S3 bucket
ETL Athena queries raw dataset for transformation
ETL Athena writes enriched result files to Gold S3 bucket
Gold S3 bucket serves as target data source for Query Athena
Admin console writes segment targeting rules into Segment RDS
Evaluation EKS fetches segment definitions from RDS
Evaluation EKS builds and triggers query execution on Query Athena
Evaluation EKS writes segment calculation outputs to Segment DynamoDB
Ad Server sends evaluation requests to EKS
Ad Server reads target segment data from Segment DynamoDB with sub-200ms latency
